data.long_meaning: The name Numou is derived from the Arabic root 'num', which means 'to rest'. In the Islamic context, this name symbolizes a deep sense of tranquility and peace. It is a name that is often given to babies who are born during times of calm and stability, or to those who are expected to bring peace and harmony to their families and communities. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, 'The strong are not those who overpower others. The strong are those who control their desires.' The name Numou embodies this concept of strength through self-control and inner peace.
